note: These are general safety reminders based on Philippine maritime guidance and local disaster-risk guidance. Always follow current instructions from ferry crews, authorities, weather advisories, and lifeguards.
seaTravel: Check the operator schedule and arrive at the port early enough for boarding.
Use authorized passenger vessels and follow port and crew instructions.
Follow the vessel's life-jacket instructions, especially on open decks.
Do not board an overcrowded vessel or a trip that exceeds its authorized passenger capacity.
Make sure ticket and passenger-manifest details are correct before boarding.
Follow the ferry operator, Philippine Coast Guard, and weather/port advisories.
beachSafety: Use designated or monitored swimming areas and follow warning signs and local safety notices.
Prefer areas with lifeguards and accessible life-saving equipment when available.
Do not swim alone; adults should closely supervise children and vulnerable swimmers.
Stay away from marked danger areas and zones used by anchored or moving watercraft.
Do not swim while drunk or otherwise unable to respond safely to changing conditions.
Keep 911 and relevant local emergency contacts accessible before entering the water.
